_doc: Every *.timer in deploy/systemd MUST be listed here (scripts/systemd-units.mts check, pre-commit). target=prod → deploy-prod.sh GATE 6 installs it on the live VPS (rendered to the prod form), enables it and VERIFIES it is enabled+active, or the deploy fails. target=dev → never installed on prod; `why` is mandatory. A timer running on prod that is not listed here as prod also fails the deploy.

citoviso-backup-dev.timer.why: a DEV adatbázist menti a dev gépen; az éles mentése a deploy GATE 3 pg_dump-ja és a VPS saját mentése

citoviso-sms-relay.timer.why: a helyi GSM-modem (SIM800C) a dev gépen ül; a relay a távoli sort erre a modemre üríti (CLAUDE.md §8)

citoviso-multilang-resume.timer.why: ma csak a dev gépen fut (a fő fából, ADR-0171 szerint); hogy élesen is kell-e, NINCS eldöntve — külön vizsgálandó (tulaj, 2026-09-23: maradjon dev)

citoviso-pair-repair.timer.why: ma csak a dev gépen fut; hogy élesen is kell-e, NINCS eldöntve — külön vizsgálandó (tulaj, 2026-09-23: maradjon dev)

_services_doc: Every *.service WITHOUT a timer of its own MUST be listed here (same prod/dev rule). ADR-0276: citoviso-alert@.service is the OnFailure= target of every prod service — a failed tick mails app_setting.alert_email; the template is installed by GATE 6 like any prod unit (not enabled: OnFailure starts it).
